fields.summary_ko.0: Eli Lilly (LLY) Q3 revenue increased 39% year-over-year to $24.4B, with Zepbound sales up 49% to $5.4B, raising 2026 revenue guidance to $91–92B.
fields.summary_ko.1: Competitor Viking Therapeutics (VKTX) achieved average 14.7% weight loss in the 13-week Phase 2 trial of VK2735, with Phase 3 results expected within 12–18 months.
